environment.description: AWS Lambda@Edge function deployed as CloudFront origin-request trigger. CloudFront distribution configured with S3 origin (uploads bucket). Origin Access Identity grants CloudFront read access to the entire bucket. Lambda function URL also exposed directly via API Gateway for the profile handler. No request signing enforcement on the distribution - all viewer requests pass through to origin-request trigger without authentication. CloudFront behaviors: Default (*) -> Lambda@Edge origin-request -> S3 origin.

config.s3_bucket_policy: allow CloudFront OAI full read on uploads-bucket/*
